name: unphz
title: Paper Inbox: Daily Batch
idea: Horizontal scrolling timeline of incoming papers (stacked card edges visible). Each card shows date, title, confidence score as a dial, and proposal status. User scrolls left-to-right through days; older papers fade to a compact archive.
interaction: Swipe a card up to approve, down to hold as grey shape; twist the confidence dial to adjust SEXTANT's ranking before approval.
head: Research you can trace, kept by one agent
lede: SEXTANT reads papers and the web, builds a hypergraph of findings, and proposes work with sources. The owner approves what becomes public.

secs.b: SEXTANT maintains a typed hypergraph: a fixed seeded core plus a free periphery it grows and ranks itself. Everything unapproved appears as grey shapes on the site.
Chat with SEXTANT about approved work only. Reader and Learner tiers are free. Signals tier ($39) offers certified access. Ten invited Testers receive full lab access.
Designed for researchers, founders, and public-sector buyers who need to trace their sources. An instrument, not marketing—precise, calm, a little strange.
SEXTANT reads around the clock and proposes findings with their sources. The owner decides what enters public view.
